title: A Spoon of Neutron Star Weighs Billions of Tons
description: A single teaspoon of neutron star material would weigh billions of tons on Earth.

scenes.text: A single teaspoon of a neutron star would weigh billions of tons here on Earth.
A neutron star is what can be left after a giant star explodes. Its core collapses into a tiny ball.
It packs more mass than our Sun into a sphere about the size of a city.
Gravity there is so strong that atoms are crushed together, until they are mostly packed neutrons.
The heaviest spoonful in the universe. Follow for more weird facts.
